headline: Forza Horizon 6 PS5 January 26
title: Forza Horizon 6 PS5 Release Date January 26 | First Expansion Too | Gaming News
video_script: Forza Horizon six is coming to PlayStation 5 on January twenty sixth, twenty twenty seven. It first launched on Xbox Series and PC on May nineteenth. Premium Edition buyers get early access on January twenty first, along with the first expansion. The PS5 version supports cross play and cross save. Will you play it on PS5? Comment below!
description: Forza Horizon 6 launches on PS5 January 26, 2027 (Premium Edition early access January 21, with the first expansion). Originally launched May 19, 2026 on Xbox Series and PC. Sources: Gematsu, Pure Xbox, Inven Global.
